   "description": "Играй в FOOTBALL Kicks и испытай настоящие пенальти!\n\nВ одной из лучших бесплатных игр в футбол тебя ждет множество удивительных испытаний с пенальти.\n\nНаслаждайся неограниченными соревнованиями, полными экшена, даже в многопользовательском режиме.\n\nСоздавай и настраивай свою команду по своему желанию, улучшая своих игроков с помощью множества открываемых предметов, усердно тренируйся, совершенствуй свой пенальти, чтобы забивать лучшие голы, побеждать соперников и стать звездой игры в футбол!\n\n\nХАРАКТЕРИСТИКИ\n\n- Два режима игры: Цели или Свободные удары\n- Создавай, улучшай и настраивай свою команду и оборудование\n- Получи Сезонный пропуск, чтобы получить еще большие награды\n- Зарабатывай достижения\n- Собирай уникальные комплекты\n- Футбольный магазин с ежедневными предложениями и различными наборами\n- Вращай колесо удачи, чтобы получить больше призов\n\n\nТы никогда раньше не играл в такие игры. Эта игра с пенальти даст тебе лучший опыт в реальном испытании.\n\nИграй против друзей или позволь игре найти соперника, чтобы увидеть, насколько ты хорош в футбольных пенальти.\n\nНе упусти шанс обыграть в футбол всех игроков со всего мира!\n\nВыигрывай испытания, зарабатывай монеты, улучшай свою команду, чтобы полностью раскрыть потенциал каждого игрока, и продвигайся в режиме Цели или Свободные удары, чтобы получить больше уникальных бонусов.\n\nПродемонстрируй свой стиль, навыки и точность!\n\nСкачай FOOTBALL Kicks и стань легендой игры в футбол!",

   "releaseNotes": "Avec cette mise à jour, découvrez le guide de la Coupe du monde de football 2026 ainsi qu'une nouvelle version du format numérique de notre article « Les Notes » :\n\n- Une interface graphique modernisée et plus agréable à consulter\n- L’affichage de la nationalité ou du club selon le type de rencontre\n- L'affichage des faits de match : buts, passes décisives, cartons, remplacements\n- L’ajout de statistiques détaillées et de la heatmap pour chaque joueur \n\nNe manquez rien de l'actualité de l'évènement sportif de l'année en vous inscrivant à notre alerte spéciale Coupe du monde 2026 ainsi qu'à celles des 48 sélections engagées !",
   "version": "10.60.1",

   "currency": "RUB",
   "description": "Téléchargez gratuitement l’application L’Équipe pour iPhone et iPad, la référence des applications de sport ! \n\nL’application L’Équipe c’est toute L’Équipe sur une seule application gratuite avec plus de 150 articles, podcasts et vidéos produits chaque jour par les journalistes de la rédaction. Mais aussi votre journal quotidien, la chaîne L'Équipe et les résultats en direct.\n\n\nSuivez notamment les plus grandes compétitions sportives (ligue des champions, ligue 1, Premier League, Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Top 14…), les plus grands événements sportifs de la planète (Coupe du Monde, Euro, Tour de France, Roland Garros, Jeux olympiques, Super Bowl, 6 Nations, Formule 1…) et toutes les informations mercato !\n\n\nA retrouver sur l'application :\n\nL’actualité en direct 24h/24 : accédez aux derniers articles, aux dernières brèves et aux dernières vidéos de L'Équipe. Suivez toutes vos compétitions préférées (Ligue 1, Ligue 2, Ligue des champions, championnats étrangers, Coupe du Monde et Euro…) et avec les alertes personnalisées ne ratez rien de toute l'actualité sportive.\n\nL'Équipe Explore : la nouvelle plateforme de contenus réservés uniquement aux abonnés. Chaque semaine, explorez le sport à travers des enquêtes, des séries, des stories, des podcasts ou des documentaires interactifs. \n\nL'Équipe Live : suivez chaîne L’Équipe en direct et en replay, le programme des événements à venir, toutes vos émissions préférées (L’Équipe de Greg, L’Équipe du soir, La petite lucarne…), et un grand catalogue d’événements sportifs : Ligue des nations, Ballon d'Or, biathlon, Copa America, Coupe du monde des clubs, Coupe du Roi, ATP 250, Biathlon, Formule E, Meeting d’athlétisme, handball, ski alpin…\n\nKiosque : tous les matins, dès 00h30, profitez du journal quotidien L’Équipe sur iPhone et iPad. Avec son sommaire, son zoom performant et sa fonction de lecture article par article profitez d’un vrai confort de lecture et emmenez votre journal partout avec vous. Téléchargez également les autres titres du groupe L’Équipe : le Magazine, Vélo Magazine, France Football, les Hors-Série…\n\nDirects : suivez l'évolution des scores de tous les matches en direct à travers des statistiques détaillées et des commentaires en temps réel de la rédaction. Configurez vos favoris et vos alertes et suivez l’évolution du score de vos rencontres et de vos événements préférées. Et retrouvez tous les classements, résultats et statistiques à travers nos fiches joueurs et nos fiches équipes.\n\nL’application propose plusieurs offres d’abonnement à partir de 9,99€/mois (1er mois à 0,99€) sans engagement permettant d’accéder à : \n- tous les articles abonnés en illimités, \n- l’intégralité des contenus L'Équipe Explore (enquêtes, des séries, des stories, des podcasts)\n- le journal quotidien en version numérique dès 00h30 \n- des rencontres abonnés inédites avec des sportifs de haut niveau\n- des réductions sur la boutiques des Unes et photos \n- des contenus personnalisés \n- les notes des matches…\n- Plusieurs comptes simultanés\n\nSi vous ne souhaitez pas vous abonner mais quand même faire partie de notre communauté L'Équipe, vous pouvez créer un compte gratuitement et profiter de nos avantages membres : \n- Mise en favoris de vos contenus préférés \n- Espace commentaire \n- Personnalisation des alertes \n- Newsletters personnalisées \n- Intégralité des vidéos (Live) \n- espace jeux\n\nNote : le montant de l’abonnement est débité sur votre compte iTunes automatiquement à la confirmation de l’abonnement. L’abonnement est automatiquement reconduit sauf si cette option est désactivée dans les vingt-quatre heures précédant la fin de la période en cours.\nL’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en vous rendant sur votre compte dans l’App Store après l’achat.\n\nSi vous avez une question, ou que vous rencontrez un problème technique, n’hésitez pas à consulter nos CGV : http://webview.lequipe.fr/Fonctions/cgv.html",

   "currentVersionReleaseDate": "2026-05-28T20:27:21Z",
   "releaseNotes": "- Добавлена вкладка «WC2026» в панель вкладок\n- Улучшена статистика матчей\n- Исправлены ошибки",
   "version": "8.9.0",
   "wrapperType": "software",
   "currency": "RUB",
   "description": "Следи за Los Galácticos в любое время и из любого места вместе с нашей большой фан-общиной. Это не просто спортивное приложение — это полноценная платформа для болельщиков Реал Мадрид с чатами, блогами, мнениями и постоянными обновлениями.\n\nТы настоящий мадридиста? Real Live станет твоим главным помощником во всём, что связано с Реал Мадрид. Будь на связи с «Сантьяго Бернабеу» благодаря лайв-обновлениям, эксклюзивному контенту и всему необходимому, чтобы следить за Los Blancos максимально детально.\nПолучай вся важная информация о клубе за секунды: новости, расписание, результаты, аналитические статьи, LIVE-счёт, уведомления о голах, фан-чаты и инструменты для создания собственных постов о Los Merengues — всё для настоящего болельщика.\nНаше футбольное приложение бесплатное и позволяет следить за командой где бы ты ни находился.\n\nКаждый фан Los Blancos получает:\n\nЛайв-обновления матчей: мгновенные результаты, детальная статистика и текстовые комментарии к каждому матчу. Следи за игрой так, будто ты на трибунах Бернабеу.\n\nЭксклюзивные новости: последние данные о трансферах, превью матчей, официальные заявления. Обсуждай подтверждённые сделки, слухи и экспертные мнения.\n\nРасписание и результаты: будь в курсе предстоящих матчей, прошлых итогов и турнирных таблиц. Изучай составы, тактический разбор, постматчевые отчёты и редакционные статьи.\n\nПрофили игроков: подробные статистические данные, достижения и ключевые моменты карьеры звёзд. Вся информация о команде и игроках включена.\n\nФан-сообщество: общайся с другими мадридистами, делись мнениями и вместе празднуй победы. Присоединяйся к блог-платформе и публикуй собственные материалы внутри приложения.\n\nПерсональные уведомления: настраивай, какие алерты получать — старт матча, голы, важные новости, составы, карточки, результаты и др. Есть «тихий режим» на время отдыха.\n\nМультимедиа-контент: смотри хайлайты, эксклюзивные интервью и закулисные видео.\n\nСледи за всеми турнирами, где выступают Los Galácticos — Ла Лига, Лига чемпионов УЕФА, Кубок Испании, Суперкубок и международные товарищеские матчи.\n\nНаслаждайся расширенным разделом статистики:\n• Матч-центр 24/7 с лайв-обновлениями и сравнением соперников\n• Список травмированных\n• Информация об арендованных игроках\n• Карьера тренера как футболиста\n• Детали трансферов и их стоимость\n\nБудь ты на «Бернабеу» или поддерживаешь команду на расстоянии — это приложение держит всю атмосферу Реал Мадрид прямо в твоих руках.\n\nЛучшие варианты подписки для преданных фанатов:\n• Месячная подписка\n• Годовая подписка\n\nПриложение не является официальным и не создано при поддержке клуба. Его разработали фанаты для фанатов. В следующих обновлениях будут новые функции — оставайся с нами, чтобы получить лучший опыт.\nПо вопросам и предложениям пиши на: support.90live@tribuna.com\n\nСкачай сейчас и покажи свою любовь к самому титулованному клубу в истории футбола!\nHala Madrid!",

   "description": "Футбол 24 – абсолютно новий, супершвидкий застосунок від головного футбольного медіа України. Тут є все для тих, хто живе грою – миттєві онлайн-результати матчів, останні новини футболу, палкі батли у коментарях і турнір прогнозів.\n\nНОВІ ФІШКИ ФУТБОЛ 24\n\n• Функціональний матч-центр: календар, розклад та онлайн-трансляції матчів з-понад 100 футбольних ліг і кубків. Зручні Live-фільтри дозволяють в один клік дивитися ігри, що тривають просто зараз.\n• Повна футбольна статистика та аналіз кожної гри: склади команд, візуальні тактичні схеми, рейтинг та оцінки гравців, історія особистих зустрічей (H2H) та детальна мапа активності на полі.\n• Обрані новини про футбол – налаштуй власну стрічку \"Обраного\" та читай тільки те, що тобі важливо, а також дивись розклад і результати матчів вподобаних команд.\n• Рахунок обраного матчу на заблокованому екрані (iOS Live Activities) – дізнавайся про голи миттєво. Завдяки Dynamic Island поточний рахунок та хвилина матчу відображаються прямо на екрані блокування. Тобі навіть не потрібно розблоковувати телефон!\n• Кастомні сповіщення – підписуйся на оперативні пуші про футбольні новини та ігри обраних команд. Отримуй сповіщення про початок гри, голи, картки та фінальний рахунок із фірмовими звуками трибун чи свистка.\n• Турнір прогнозистів – перевір свою футбольну інтуїцію. Роби прогнози на топ-матчі в один клік, змагайся з тисячами вболівальників у загальному лідерборді та доводь, що ти – експерт.\n• Живе спілкування – обговорюй матчі у зручних гілках коментарів, отримуй лайки від однодумців та піднімай свій особистий рейтинг у нашій спільноті однодумців.\n\nСтеж за ЧС 2026, УПЛ, збірною України, єврокубками та топ-лігами разом із Футбол 24 – українським медіа, яке працює для справжніх фанатів уже понад 15 років. We recently launched support for Canadian Junior A Hockey and have scores from British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Ontario.  There is coverage of English Premiere League, Bundesliga, La Liga, Liga MX, Serie A, Ligue 1, and English League Championship.\n\nWe have scores in states like Alaska, Hawaii, Texas, California, Florida, Georgia, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Illinois, Mississippi, Arizona, Alabama, Louisiana, Ohio, Missouri, Indiana, Minnesota, Virginia, New York, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah, South Carolina, Wisconsin and others. \n\nWe also have settings that allow you to score games for competitive, recreational, travel ball, college, NJCAA, CCCAA, NAIA, NCAA and professional games. # 🪄Lineup Optimizer

Optimizing lineups is a critical part of DFS Success

## [Direct link to heading](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app/feature-guides/lineup-optimizer\#how-does-the-lineup-optimizer-work)    How Does The Lineup Optimizer Work?

LineStar's 3rd Generation Lineup Optimizer is a patented, powerful tool that uses sophisticated algorithms to generate the most optimal lineups for daily fantasy sports (DFS) based on a variety of factors and more than 100+ individual data points per athlete.

First, the optimizer takes into account player's [DFS Projections](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app/feature-guides/dfs-projections), which are updated in real-time using a mix of historical data, recent performances, and expected matchups. These projections are calculated using advanced statistical models to provide a robust estimate of a player's likely performance.

Next, the optimizer incorporates additional factors like player salaries, positions, and contest rules for different DFS platforms like DraftKings, FanDuel, and Yahoo. This ensures that the generated lineups are not only high-scoring but also adhere to the specific constraints of each specific individual DFS platform.

The Lineup Optimizer also considers the concept of [Projected Ownership](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app/feature-guides/projected-ownership). By identifying less popular picks who are projected to perform well, value picks, it allows users to create unique lineups that can provide a competitive edge in large tournaments.

Users can customize their lineups further by locking in certain players they want to include, excluding players they want to avoid, and a variety of advanced setting options such as player or team stacking.

Finally, the Lineup Optimizer can generate lineup sets of 150+ at a time, giving users a range of options to choose from. This is particularly beneficial for users who wish to enter multiple entries in a single contest or different contests. You can directly EXPORT optimized lineups from LineStar into supported DFS platforms like DraftKings and FanDuel.

In short, LineStar's Lineup Optimizer is designed to help users build winning lineups efficiently, backed by data-driven insights and customizable features.

## [Direct link to heading](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app/feature-guides/lineup-optimizer\#how-to-use-the-optimizer)    How to Use the Optimizer

It's omni-present on the right-hand side of your browser throughout the projections page.

As you start to 🔒 lock players in, you'll notice they appear on the right hand side.

DFS optimizers like LineStar are used for several key reasons:

1. **Efficiency**: Creating DFS lineups manually can be time-consuming and complex. Optimizers streamline the process, generating numerous lineups quickly and efficiently based on various factors like player projections, matchups, and salary constraints.

2. **Data Analysis**: Optimizers utilize large amounts of data and sophisticated algorithms to provide projections and insights that would be difficult to calculate manually. This can include player performance trends, team dynamics, and other complex variables.

3. **Strategy Implementation**: Whether it's stacking players from the same team, diversifying lineups, or ensuring salary cap efficiency, optimizers can help implement various DFS strategies, tailoring lineups to fit specific game formats.

4. **Informed Decision-Making**: Through up-to-date player projections, injury updates, and other real-time data, optimizers support users in making more informed decisions, helping them adjust their lineups right up to game time.

5. **Back-testing Strategies**: Many optimizers offer features that allow users to back-test their strategies using historical data. This helps players refine their strategies and learn from past performance.

6. **Competitive Edge**: Given the complexity and competitiveness of DFS, using an optimizer can provide a critical advantage, helping users stay competitive in their leagues or tournaments.


## [Direct link to heading](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app/feature-guides/lineup-optimizer\#what-are-the-best-settings-for-the-optimizer)    What are the Best Settings for the Optimizer?

The optimizer isn't a one-size-fits-all situation.

The optimal settings depend largely on your desired outcome, the sport you're optimizing for, and your overall game theory.

Here are a few examples to illustrate this:

1. **High Ceiling**: If you're aiming for a high-potential, riskier lineup (ideal for GPP tournaments), you may want to adjust the settings to favor players with higher ceilings, despite their lower floors. This could involve increasing the weightage for players projected to have a breakout performance.

2. **Low Floor**: Conversely, for cash games where consistency is more valuable, you may want to prioritize players with a higher floor – consistent performers who are less likely to bottom out.

3. **Best Values**: This strategy targets players who offer the most bang for your buck, often underpriced players projected to perform well. The optimizer can be set to prioritize these value picks.

4. **Utilizing Stacks**: In sports where correlation plays a significant role (like NFL or MLB), you can adjust the optimizer to focus on player stacks (QB-WR in NFL, or pitcher-batter in MLB, for example).

5. **Correlation and Expected Odds/Outcomes**: If you have a strong understanding of game theory, you could adjust the optimizer settings to align with predicted game scripts or outcomes. For example, in an NBA game, if you expect a blowout, you might adjust for a lineup that includes bench players who will see more playtime.

# 👋Welcome to LineStar App

Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) & Props & Legalized Sports Gambling

**LineStar Pro tip:** Have fun! Fantasy sports were invented specifically to make watching games more enjoyable. DFS can often be a frustrating experience especially when you're just learning. Like many things in life, relax, and enjoy the journey!

## [Direct link to heading](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app\#overview)    Overview

**The Origin**

Born in the heart of the DFS industry in 2014, LineStar stands as the original, patented lineup optimizer—a testament to our unwavering commitment to innovation. Through our in-depth understanding of the industry, we offer an unrivaled fusion of advanced sports knowledge and affordable rates, fostering a loyal customer base that has stood by us for years.

**Feedback Loop**

Our customers are the heart of our operation, and we believe in fostering a two-way conversation. We listen, we understand, and we adapt—rapidly and effectively—to the ever-evolving landscape of daily fantasy sports. Our agility keeps us ahead of the curve, consistently delivering up-to-date and relevant features that cater to our users' needs.

[If you have an idea or question - contact us! We are based in the US and respond to every e-mail.](https://www.linestarapp.com/Help/Contact)

**Continual Improvement**

As we grow, we are not just confined to the world of DFS. Recognizing the burgeoning trends, we've expanded our coverage to include Props and legal sports gambling markets, further broadening our horizons while keeping our customers at the core.

**Likeminded Community**

At LineStar, we are more than just a DFS tool. We are a community of sports enthusiasts, a hub of cutting-edge technology, and a platform where sports, data, and strategy converge. Whether you're a seasoned DFS veteran or a newcomer looking to make your mark, LineStar is your trusted partner on this exciting journey. Join us, and together, let's redefine the world of daily fantasy sports.

### [Direct link to heading](https://linestar.gitbook.io/linestar-app\#over-8-500-reviews-at-4.8)    Over 8,500+ Reviews at ️4.8⭐️

- **High Ratings**: LineStar boasts an average rating of 4.8 stars from over 8,500 reviews across our native iOS/Android apps and various online platforms.

- **Customer Satisfaction**: Each review reflects a satisfied user who has discovered value in our tools and insights, contributing to our high customer satisfaction rate.

- **Continual Improvement**: Feedback from reviews drives our commitment to continual improvement, ensuring we stay in tune with our users' needs and enhance our offerings.

- **Trusted Partner**: The positive reviews reinforce LineStar's reputation as a trusted partner in the daily fantasy sports world.

- **Shared Success**: At LineStar, we view the success of our users as our own, and we strive to maintain high customer satisfaction by consistently delivering a top-notch DFS experience.


Several of our customers have won the millimaker and very large GPP tournament contests. Unlike our competitors who are entering hundreds of thousands of lineups against you.

We want you to win! We celebrate customer wins with the [LineStar MVP Program](https://www.linestarapp.com/MVP).

## Astana Team Overview

The Kazakh side head into the second leg as clear favourites. Grigori Babayan’s men are riding a five-match home winning streak, having kept three clean sheets during that run. After their victory in Albania, Astana edged out Aktobe 3-2 in the Kazakhstan Premier League. Still, they currently sit only third in the table, trailing second-placed Kairat by ten points.

The first leg in Elbasan ended in a win for Astana, but it would be a stretch to say they dominated Dinamo. In fact, as is often the case for visitors, they spent much of the match on the back foot, conceding possession (45% to 55%). They also created fewer dangerous attacks (48 to 75), but Ramazan Karimov seized his chance midway through the second half to score his first goal since May.

## Dinamo City Team Overview

The Albanian side find themselves in a tough spot after suffering a home defeat. Having lost on their own turf, Dinamo City now need to chase victory in Astana, where the artificial pitch has proven troublesome for many visiting teams. Ilir Daja’s men looked solid during pre-season friendlies, going unbeaten throughout, but European competition presents a different level of intensity and pace.

That said, Dinamo showed some positive signs - they tried to take the initiative, fully aware that much would hinge on their home result. Still, they couldn’t find the back of the net. It’s worth noting that the Tirana club have historically struggled in the Europa Conference League, managing just two wins from seven matches in the competition. Dinamo City have also lost their last two away fixtures in this tournament - falling to Hajduk (1-2) and Jagiellonia (0-3).

# Jerome Bettis Interview: Super Bowl Expectations for Aaron Rodgers, Steelers & Rams Future

![Author Profile](https://images.actionnetwork.com/blog/2026/04/DJSiddiqi.png)

[DJ Siddiqi](https://www.actionnetwork.com/article/author/djsiddiqi)

[Download App](https://action.onelink.me/qhpb/f46fa531)

Updated:

Jul 02, 2026, 11:26 AM EDT

Updated:

Jul 02, 2026, 11:26 AM EDT

![Jerome Bettis Interview: Super Bowl Expectations for Aaron Rodgers, Steelers & Rams Future article feature image](https://images.actionnetwork.com/blog/2026/07/DJEG2Y-scaled.jpg)

11 min read

Credit:
Source: Alamy/ Zuma Press, Inc.

Jerome Bettis is known as one of the greatest running backs of all time.

The Pro Football Hall of Fame running back established himself as one of the best running backs in the NFL during the 90s and early 2000s as a member of the Los Angeles Rams early in his career before moving on to the Pittsburgh Steelers. During his 13-season career, Bettis went to the Pro Bowl six times, he won Offensive Rookie of the Year and won the Super Bowl in his final game at the conclusion of the 2005 season.

The burly running back -he was 252 pounds during his career at a 5-foot-11 frame- is known as one of the best players in Steelers history, spending the final 10 years (1996-2005) of his career in Pittsburgh.

With Bettis preparing for his participation in the American Century Championship, the largest celebrity golf tournament will be broadcast on NBC and Peacock , from July 10 through July 12, he took the time to talk about a range of football topics concerning his former teams, the Steelers and the Rams.

### Q: I want to ask you about the Steelers. Aaron Rodgers has officially come back, he has said that this is going to be his last season. What are your overall thoughts on him coming back and what constitutes a successful season in his last year?

> **Bettis**: _A successful season is winning a championship. That's the goal every year. What does he measure as success? That part I don't know. But when you play for an organization like the Pittsburgh Steelers, the goal is to win a championship. If you win the division, that's always a nugget, because we play in the toughest division in football, so that's always going to be a challenge in and of itself. There's going to be small wins, but ultimately the goal is to win a championship._

### Q: Obviously for that franchise, you know better than anybody, the expectation is to win a championship now. Obviously they've made some additions. They brought in Michael Pittman Jr, they brought in the running back Rico Dowdle. Do you think that this team stacks up better than it did last year, as far as contending in a tough AFC?

> **Bettis:** _Oh, 10 times better. They got more talent. The key when you are diminished from a talent perspective, you don't give yourself a chance. And I think that's what was happening. They just didn't have enough. They had some talented players, but they just didn't have enough talented players to compete with some of the other top caliber football teams, and you saw it once they got to the playoffs, the latter part of the season when they started to struggle._
>
> _I think they understood that, and they went and tried to retool and get more talent in the building. That's what they've done, and so let's see what happens this year. Obviously, there should be some motivation knowing that this is Aaron's last year, and I think that should carry through to the team, and hopefully play with a sense of desperation._

### Q: Obviously, Mike McCarthy is an offensive guy and him and Aaron Rodgers, they worked so many years together. Rodgers is embracing this reunion, calling it a full circle moment. There's no doubt in your mind they should be a better offense this year. That's the expectation, right?

> **Bettis:** _100%, they should be a much better offense. Not only because of McCarthy, but because of the talent that they brought in. When you upgrade from a talent perspective, you should be much better on that side of the football, and that's that's what they'll get offensively._

### Q: When you look at Rodgers and his overall accomplishments through two-plus decades. What is his legacy, having played in the same era as Peyton Manning, Tom Brady, Drew Brees and so forth. What is his overall legacy to you?

> **Bettis:** _It's gonna be one of the greatest quarterbacks that has ever played the game. He won a championship. He showed us what great quarterbacks look like. He's a four-time MVP. His credentials speak for itself, and he's one of the greatest quarterbacks to have ever played the game. I think he'll go down as that and that'll be his legacy._

### Q: I want to talk about Drew Allar. That pick was actually made during the draft and whatnot. Pittsburgh is preparing for the future. What are your overall thoughts on him and what do you think he learns from Aaron?

> **Bettis:** _Well, hopefully he can pick up a whole lot. When you have a Hall of Fame player at your position in the building, you should soak up everything you can, right. Hopefully that happens, and Drew sees it, understands it, and utilizes it. Because that's a rare opportunity to have a player of that stature and ability in the building, so hopefully that helps springboard him to a great career as well._

### Q: Why do you think Pittsburgh selected him? What traits stand out most to you?

> **Bettis:** _You look at him, he's a dynamic football player. He's made some bad decisions in his day, and I think that's what you gotta clean up. But you look at the physical traits and ability, it's there. You look at him at the end of his junior year, there was talk about him being a top 10-15 pick. He decided to come back, and it didn't work out the way he wanted to, and got injured, and his stock fell, but it doesn't change that his ability is still there. His capabilities are there. I think he's a really good quarterback that just needs to learn the NFL game, and you can't ask for a better teacher than Aaron Rodgers._

### Q: I don't know if you're great with player comparisons, but with Drew, is there a certain quarterback you can think of in comparing him to somebody?

> **Bettis:** _He's a pretty big kid. He's definitely not as athletic as Ben was. Ben could move, he was a big, big dude, but he could move. I don't know if he's as athletic as Ben, but in terms of size, he's got that size. I'm thinking of the guys in the league that are that tall, he's got to be 6-foot-4, 6-foot-5 right. He's up there, so I just think from the physical perspective, he's supremely talented. He's got a big arm. He can make all the throws, so it's just about learning the NFL game, and I think he's in a great position to learn behind Aaron Rodgers._

### Q: I want to talk about the Rams. Obviously, it's an interesting situation with them. They go with Ty Simpson in the first round, even though they have a Super Bowl-caliber roster. They're trying to get over the hump. What are your overall thoughts on that pick? Obviously, they're preparing for the future, but do you feel that they maybe should have tackled another position of need as they try to win the Super Bowl right now?

> **Bettis:** _Here's the thing. When you talk about championship caliber teams, there's not much need there, right? And it's about depth. So you say, do I add another receiver? I got two great receivers, but do I add another one in depth? Do I add another offensive lineman? With them you're always gonna question the decision. If they got another receiver, people would have said you already got two. You got more depth, but it doesn't make you say, 'Wow.' No pick that they were going to take was going to make you say, 'Wow.' Because they're a championship caliber team, so I believe they did the right thing._
>
> _When you're drafting for depth, where do you want the best depth? At the quarterback position? So they did exactly what they were supposed to do. You draft for depth when you're a championship team, and the quarterback position is where you ultimately need the best depth over the course of the season, because when you lose your starting quarterback, you're in big trouble unless you've got depth right. You got another really good player right behind him, and that's what they've done._

### Q: The Rams are preparing for a situation before Matthew Stafford even retires. They're preparing for the future. You look at the Stafford situation, he just signed the extension, he signed the new contract. Could you see Matt honestly playing another few years, because this could be one of those situations where he's not even close to retiring. Could you see that happening?

> **Bettis:** _The possibility exists, but it could also go the other way. There was talk of retirement a year ago, two years ago, so it could go either way. From an organizational standpoint, do you want to take the chance of not having a quarterback for the future. I think what they're doing is the right thing. You've seen the organization that did it that way, you look at Kansas City, you look at Green Bay, you look at some of the teams that did it the way that the Rams are doing it. You can't knock what the Rams have done, because when you look at teams, for instance, you look at the Steelers. They were playing for championships, and did they ever think about the quarterback position? They did not, not until Ben was in the latter part of his career._
>
> _And by that point they were still good enough to win games, but they didn't have the opportunity to be high in the draft. That's the scenario that you deal with, and when you don't have that luxury, you wish you had it, and that's what's happening now with the Steelers. But the Rams, I think they did the right thing._

### Q: When you, when you look at this Ty Simpson kid, obviously he's not Drew Aller, he's a little bit on the smaller side, he's about 6-foot-1, 210 pounds, give or take. What are your thoughts on him? Do you have a player comparison for him?

> **Bettis:** _Not really, you got a lot of smaller guys who have been really good. One of his superpowers is accuracy. You look at the quarterbacks that have been accurate through their careers. I don't really have a comparison, because I don't want to start comparing these guys to Hall of Famers. You gotta let them develop but obviously learning behind a Hall of Fame caliber player in Matthew Stafford, you can't beat it._

### Q: With the Rams, they're so close, right? They almost beat the Seahawks in the NFC Championship Game. What do they need to do to get over the hump? Are they your favorites entering this season, or is it still the Seahawks or somebody else?

title: nfl-article-bettis.md — part 2/3
body:
> **Bettis:** _One of the favorites. The problem is, they're playing in a division that they beat each other up. They got three of the best teams in the NFC in the same division. That's tough, right? It's going to be a challenge, but yeah, I really like the Rams. The last couple years they have been an outstanding football team. They can continue on the same path._

### Q: Is it just one of those things where they need to execute in situational football? Because one play is the difference against a team like the Seahawks.

> **Bettis:** _That's right, it's just a few plays that make the difference. They could have easily won the football game against the Seahawks. That's how close they were._

### Q: What are your overall thoughts on Jeremiyah Love, Notre Dame alum like yourself? Do you have any sort of relationship with him and your overall thoughts on him?

> **Bettis:** _I got a chance to meet him, just chopped it up. Very, very minor, but he is exceptional. He's going to be spectacular as a running back. I just hope that the Cardinals give him the resources he needs to be successful. That's been a knock on the Cardinals. They haven't given the really, really good draft picks the opportunity to be great, and so that's when you look at, are they going to beef up the offensive line? Would they do some of the things that they need to do to allow him to be as great as he possibly can be?_
>
> _That's yet to be decided, we know that, but as an individual talent, I think he's one of the best running backs that I've seen come out in an awful long time. I was super high on Saquon Barkley when he came out of Penn State. I'm super high on this young man coming out of Notre Dame. He is a special, special talent._

### Q: Who is the best running back in the NFL right now?

> **Bettis:** _Bijan Robinson, no question. He does everything well, he's exceptional, runs with a lot of contact, balance, physicality. Runs inside, he does everything well. He catches the ball out of the backfield extremely well. He's super talented and he's found his kind of way in terms of the NFL as a running back. You gotta figure it out and he's figured it out and you're gonna see him explode the next couple of years._

### Q: Talk about the American Century Championship.

> **Bettis:** _It's just gonna be exciting. It's the 37th year of it, and it's getting better every year, so it's gonna be outstanding to be a part of. But for the fans, if you get a chance to watch it or see it, it's gonna be spectacular._

### Q: What is a good finish for you this year?

> **Bettis:** _My highest finish is 15th. I would love to get somewhere in the 20s. I want to be in the 20s, maybe late 20s. That's my goal. If I can get there, then it's a mission accomplished._

## NFL ATS Standings

## NFL Picks Against the Spread

A [bet against the spread](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/point-spread) is a type of wager that requires bettors to correctly guess the margin of victory in a football game rather than simply selecting the outright winner.

Let’s say there’s a game between the underdog Patriots (+7.5) and favorite Bills (-7.5). If you wager on the Bills against the spread, they have to win by at least eight points. The other option is to bet on the Patriots, who would have to either win or lose by seven points or less.

If an [NFL](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl) game ends as the exact margin of victory as the point spread, it’s considered a push. This means you get your bet refunded and you don’t incur any winnings or losses.

## NFL Standings Against the Spread

Monitoring team performance against the spread is a great way to make more educated NFL bets throughout the year. Identifying trends for specific teams can enable you to know when to pick, or to avoid, a particular spread bet based on in-season data.

The table above shows each team’s record against the spread for the 2025-26 regular season. Filter by league, conference, or division to get an in-depth look at each team. You can also sort the data by clicking on the table headers.

## How to Understand the NFL ATS Standings

Understanding the ATS standings is a key component of NFL betting. The ATS standings displays three categories of records for all 32 NFL teams: straight up, ATS, and [over/under](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/over-under-total).

Straight up is a team’s actual record (wins/losses/ties) in the NFL standings. These are the records that determine division standings and playoff seeding in each conference. Within this category, the home and away records are also available.

The ATS standings show each team’s home and away mark against the spread during the season. The over/under category of the standings pertains to each team’s record for [totals](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/over-under-total).

## Largest and Smallest Spreads in Super Bowl History

The Super Bowl is by far the most prominent sporting event in the United States. As such, betting ATS is an extremely popular form of wagering on the NFL’s championship contest.

The largest spread in Super Bowl history occurred in 1995. The 49ers were massive 18.5-point favorites against the then-San Diego Chargers in Super Bowl XXIX. Anchored by Super Bowl MVP quarterback Steve Young, the 49ers managed to cover the spread with a 49-26 win.

On the other end, the smallest Super Bowl spread happened exactly two decades later in 2015.

Super Bowl XLIX between the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks didn’t have a spread and was a pick’em. This means that bettors were able to merely select which team would outright win.

The game proved to be as tight as expected. The Patriots edged the Seahawks 28-24 thanks to Malcolm Butler’s interception at the 1-yard line within seconds remaining.

Check out who is favored to win this year’s Super Bowl by viewing our [NFL futures](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures) page!

## Variables That Can Alter NFL ATS Betting

NFL ATS betting can often fluctuate for a variety of reasons.

Injuries are one of the main factors. For example, whenever an NFL team’s star quarterback is listed out for a certain game, the spread will move. This is since sportsbooks are going to alter the [NFL odds](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds) to reflect the team’s new potential to cover the spread in light of the news.

Another thing that makes a difference for ATS betting is the weather. Unlike in baseball, football games are played in extreme weather conditions. The [best sportsbooks](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews) will often take into account weather situations such as snow, rain, and wind when setting the spread for NFL games.

Also, if a team is getting a large amount of money bet on them, that can impact the line. Sportsbooks could alter the spread to promote more betting on the other team so that they lessen their potential risk.

## Pros and Cons of NFL ATS Betting

Similar to other forms of sports betting, there’s positives and negatives for wagering against the spread.

Here’s some of the pros and cons to weigh:

**Pros**

**Potential for larger payouts:** Betting against the spread can be more rewarding than merely wagering on the [moneyline](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/moneyline). This is especially the case when betting on underdogs who cover the spread or favorites that win in blowout fashion.

**Evened out odds:** The point spread is geared towards balancing the playing field to create more evened odds juxtaposed against the favorite and underdog. This caters to those who are seeking to discover value on each side of the wager.

**Chances to use strategy**: ATS betting allows you the opportunity to do some homework to spot any noticeable trends or patterns that can be advantageous. Being as informed as possible is highly beneficial.

**Cons**

**Susceptibility to line movement**: Expert bettors and the overall betting volume can influence the movement of the line. This can make the spread less desirable prior to placing a bet on a particular team.

## NFL Futures Odds

## NFL Futures Betting

**An NFL "futures" bet is a wager on an event that will be determined later in the NFL season**, beyond the current week's game. Often, NFL futures center around **end-of-season results like a team to win a championship or a player to win an award**. If the selected team or players wins the event on which the wager was placed, the bettor wins their bet.

### Understanding NFL Futures and Payouts

NFL futures odds are [NFL predictions](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/) associated with larger payouts, which is why it is not uncommon to see high odds like +6000. The high NFL futures odds ranges show just how difficult it is to predict an outcome far into the future, so that is why bettors who pick correctly are rewarded so well in futures wagers. Even the NFL teams that are seen as preseason favorites to win the Super Bowl will be " [plus-money](https://www.actionnetwork.com/how-to-bet-on-sports/general/sports-betting-for-beginners-10-things-to-know#Moneylines)" that far in advance.

NFL futures odds are available prior to the season and will update throughout the year based on team and player performances. This gives bettors an opportunity to place a futures wager at almost any time during the NFL season. Don't wait too long to bet, though on NFL futures odds. Payout odds are likely to shift as the outcomes become more clear throughout the season, meaning a smaller potential payout in the end.

## NFL Player of the Year Odds

In addition to the NFL MVP award, there are a number of other individual awards given to players each season. Considering the MVP award almost always goes to a quarterback (like the pro version of the Heisman Trophy), the NFL has other offensive and defensive awards for players to pursue.

Here's a look at NFL Player of the Year Odds:

> ### NFL Offensive Player of the Year (OPOY) Odds
>
> With the MVP trophy almost always going to a quarterback, this is the award for which other offensive players can aim. The [NFL OPOY](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures/offensive-player-of-the-year-odds) is typically given to either the running back or wide receivers with the best stats on the season. It's also possible that a player wins the OPOY and the MVP in the same season. Saquon Barkley took home the honors for the 2024-25 season.

> ### NFL Defensive Player of the Year (DPOY) Odds
>
> The NFL Defensive Player of the Year award can go to any player around the defense on the field. Sometimes, a defensive end or tackle gets it; sometimes, a linebacker or cornerback can get it. There isn't one specific stat that reigns supreme over others, but sacks, total tackles and interceptions can play a large part in [claiming the DPOY award](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures/defensive-player-of-the-year-odds). Patrick Surtain II won the 2024-25 NFL Defensive Player of the Year award.

> ### NFL Comeback Player of the Year (CPOY) Odds
>
> The [NFL CPOY award](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures/comeback-player-of-the-year-odds) is given to a player who's overcome some adversity in the past and has returned to put together a strong, or even stellar, performance during the regular season. This award has caused much controversy as previous winners, such as Geno Smith and Joe Flacco, only overcame an injury after breaking out in their CPOY award year. So, the NFL has changed the criteria for the upcoming season to "honor a player who has demonstrated resilience in the face of adversity by overcoming illness, physical injury or other circumstances that led him to miss playing time the previous season." For the 2024-25 season, the winner was Joe Burrow.

> ### NFL Offensive Rookie of the Year (OROY) Odds
>
> Since a rookie QB is unlikely to contend for the MVP, the [OROY race](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures/offensive-rookie-of-the-year-odds) throws an extra position into the mix. The award goes to the best offensive rookie of the season. After a historic rookie campaign, Jayden Daniels ran away with the honors a season ago. Any offensive player is eligible, but "sexy" stats tend to be required to be considered (sorry, linemen).

> ### NFL Defensive Rookie of the Year (DROY) Odds
>
> Like the OROY, the [DROY award](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures/defensive-rookie-of-the-year-odds) goes to the top rookie of the year but on the defensive side of the ball. The best rookies come from somewhere around the top of the draft, so pay attention to those first few draft picks on either side of the ball that could compete for individual awards. Jared Verse won the 2024-25 award.

## Bet on NFL Futures

After a long season and the NFL Playoffs eliminating teams from 14 to two for the Super Bowl, oddsmakers will set American Odds on the NFL championship match-up. At this point, these are no longer NFL future odds -- the main event is near!

For additional resources, check out our [betting calculators](https://www.actionnetwork.com/betting-calculators) . But here are the fast facts on betting odd types and how to bet on the Super Bowl.

For those in Illinois, you can also check out the [bet365 Illinois Bonus Code](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/bet365-illinois)!

### ![](https://assets.actionnetwork.com/558503_action-check.png) What are American Odds?

> **American Odds** are the default odds at U.S. sportsbooks. The odds are based on winning $100 for a given bet on either the Favorite or the Underdog.  **A Favorite** will **have a minus (-)** sign next to the odds and represents the **money you need to risk to win $100**. **An Underdog** will **have a plus (+) sign in front** and represents the **money you can win for every $100 risked**. So, if you're betting on the Bucs at -140 against the Chiefs, that means Tampa Bay is a slight favorite. You need to risk $140 to win $100 on the Bucs. If they win, you profit $100 and get your original $140 back.

### ![](https://assets.actionnetwork.com/558503_action-check.png) What are Decimal Odds?

> Beyond the U.S., most of the world uses **Decimal Odds**, in part because it’s easier to convert them to implied probabilities. Decimal odds represent the **amount you win for every $1 wagered**. And the number **represents the total return**, not just the profit (this is different from American and fractional odds).

### ![](https://assets.actionnetwork.com/558503_action-check.png)What are Fractional Odds?

> **Fractional Odds** are used primarily in Ireland and the United Kingdom. Few bettors use fractional odds for betting sports other than horse racing, because the conversions to understand return are challenging. To calculate winnings on fractional odds, multiply your bet by the top number (the numerator), then divide the result by the bottom number (the denominator).

Our [Sports Betting Glossary](https://www.actionnetwork.com/how-to-bet-on-sports/general/sports-betting-terms "Sports Betting Glossary") is also a helpful resource.

- This page will host the latest in expert NFL predictions & betting analysis.
- Understanding key NFL betting types, including [point spreads](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/point-spread "Point Spread Education"), [moneylines](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/moneyline "Moneyline Education"), and [totals](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/over-under-total "Totals Education") (aka over/unders), is essential for developing effective betting strategies.

- Advanced betting options like [parlays](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/parlay "Parlay Education"), [teasers](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/teaser "Teaser Education"), and [prop bets](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/prop-bet "Prop Betting Education") can offer higher potential returns but require a deeper understanding of the game.

- Staying informed about [NFL team](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/teams "NFL Teams Hub") news, [NFL injury reports](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/injury-report "NFL Injury Reports"), and expert analyses housed here significantly enhances betting decision-making, improving the chances of successful wagers.


### Understanding NFL Odds and Betting Lines

There are various ways to bet on an NFL game. A popular approach is the betting spread, but there’s also moneyline and totals betting. Each market type offers unique strategies that seasoned bettors use to maximize their chances of winning.

Point spreads handicap the favored team by assigning a point value, while moneyline bets involve picking the outright winner without considering the point spread. The odds associated with these bets reflect the cost to place that particular bet, often expressed as a negative number for favorites and a positive number for underdogs.

Point spreads are influenced by team skill and various factors, determining the margin of victory needed for a bet to win. Recognizing these margins, known as [key numbers](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/nfl-key-betting-numbers-spread-margins-of-victory-line-value "Key Betting Numbers Education"), is essential, as they frequently occur in football games. Additionally, the “ [juice](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/juice "Juice in Betting Education")” or commission charged by sportsbooks affects the required winning percentage to break even.

With a firm grasp of these basics, you’re ready to explore the popular types of NFL bets. See here for the latest [NFL odds](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds "NFL Odds Hub").

### Popular Types of NFL Bets

NFL betting offers several popular types of bets, each with its own strategies and potential rewards. The main types are point spread, NFL moneylines, totals (over/under) bets, and NFL lines. Our content often covers guidance on picks and predictions for each. Each bet type appeals to different betting styles, whether you prefer predicting the outright winner, the margin of victory, or the combined score of both teams.

Let's break down each of these bet types in detail.

#### Point Spread Betting

Point spread betting is a performance-based measure that handicaps the favored team by assigning a point value, making the game more balanced for betting purposes. For instance, if the [Kansas City Chiefs](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds/kansas-city-chiefs%22 " Kansas City Chiefs Odds") style have a point spread of -7, they must win by more than seven points for a bet on them to win. Conversely, if the underdog has a +7 spread, they must win or lose by fewer than seven points for the bettor to win.

A practical example is the [49ers](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds/san-francisco-49ers "San Francisco 49ers Odds") vs. [Seahawks](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds/seattle-seahawks "Seahawks") Monday Night Football game where the 49ers might be -5 favorites. To cover the spread, the 49ers need to win by more than five points. If they win by exactly five points, the bet is a push, and the stakes are refunded. This type of betting requires a keen understanding of team performances and the ability to predict the margin of victory.

Each point spread bet has specific odds, often expressed as -110. This means you need to wager $110 to win $100.

#### Moneyline Betting

[Moneyline](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/moneyline) betting is the simplest way to bet. In this method, you select which team will win the game outright without any point spread considerations. The moneyline odds are expressed as positive or negative numbers, indicating the underdog and the favorite, respectively. For example, a positive number like +200 means a $100 bet will yield $200 if the underdog wins, while a negative number like -150 means you need to bet $150 to win $100 if the favorite wins.

In moneyline betting, the outcome is straightforward:

- If your chosen team wins, you win the bet.

- In cases of a tie on a moneyline bet with a 2-way line, it results in a push, meaning the bet is refunded.

- If it’s a 3-way line, a tie results in a loss.


This simplicity makes moneyline betting a popular choice for many bettors.

#### Totals Betting (Over/Under)

Totals betting, also known as [over/under betting](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/over-under-total), focuses on the combined score of both teams in a game. Oddsmakers set a predicted total, and bettors wager on whether the actual combined score will be over or under this number. For instance, if the total is set at 48.5, a bet on the over wins if the combined score is 49 or more, while a bet on the under wins if it’s 48 or fewer.

The payout in totals betting is determined by your bet on the total. If you bet on the over and the total score exceeds the set number, you win. Conversely, if you bet on the under and the total is lower, you win. If the total points scored match the line set by the sportsbook, the bet is considered a push, and the wager is reimbursed.

Analyzing team scoring trends and performance on both sides of the ball can significantly influence your over/under predictions. This form of betting adds another layer of excitement to NFL games, as every point scored can affect your wager’s outcome.

### Advanced NFL Betting Options

For those looking to elevate their betting game, advanced NFL betting options can offer higher payouts but come with increased risks. These include parlay betting, teaser betting, and prop betting. Each of these options requires a deeper understanding of the game and strategic thinking to maximize potential returns.

Now, let’s delve into these advanced betting options.

[Parlay](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/parlay) betting involves combining multiple bets into a single wager, significantly raising the stakes. In a parlay, you can combine 3 to 12 bets, but all selections must win for the bet to payout. This increases potential returns but also the risk, as losing a single bet means losing the entire parlay.

The allure of parlay betting lies in its potential for higher payouts because outcomes are harder to predict. For instance, adding more selections to NFL parlays increases potential winnings, reflecting the decreased likelihood of winning the bet. Same-game parlays, where multiple outcomes from a single game are combined, are becoming increasingly popular due to their potential for larger payouts. Use our [parlay betting calculator](https://www.actionnetwork.com/betting-calculators/parlay-calculator "Parlay Betting Calculator") to determine your odds.

#### Teaser Betting

[Teaser](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/teaser) betting is a type of parlay that allows bettors to adjust the point spreads for a lower-risk wager compared to standard parlays. Typically, a teaser involves a two-team bet with a six-point adjustment to the spreads, offering a payout similar to a standard bet at odds of -120. This adjustment makes it easier to win the bet, although the potential payout is lower.

Teasers are advantageous for navigating critical scoring margins, as many NFL games result in victory margins of 1 to 7 points. By shopping for the best odds and using 6-point teasers, bettors can enhance their chances of long-term profitability. Check out our [NFL Teasers](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/teaser-tips-strategy-guide) betting guide here.

#### Prop Betting

[Prop betting](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/prop-bet) focuses on specific events within a game that are not directly related to the final outcome. These bets can include metrics like total touchdowns, player yards, or even novelty props during major events. Prop bets have grown in popularity, offering more opportunities for bettors compared to traditional bet types.

Most prominent American sportsbooks offer a variety of NFL player props, making it easier for bettors to find value in these markets. Prop bets enhance game engagement and can often be easier to exploit than traditional betting markets. Check out all of Action Network’s [NFL Props](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/props) and [NFL Prop Projections](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/prop-projections).

title: nfl-odds.md — part 3/4
body:
## Where Can I Bet on the NFL? Legal online sports betting is currently available across over 30 states, including Washington, D.C.! You can see the status of sports betting in your state with [Action Network's legalization tracker](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting). Several states are in the process of creating or voting on legislation that would legalize mobile sports betting. Be sure to follow the news if you're pending. ## Understanding NFL Odds If you’re new to sports betting, specifically NFL betting, our standard odds tables may be overwhelming. This NFL betting guide will give you the foundational information to understand basic betting terminology, interpret game odds, and utilize moneylines to help you make educated weekly [NFL picks](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/picks). Of course, uou can also check out our [NFL ATS standings](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/against-the-spread-standings). Throughout this guide, we will use the odds table for Super Bowl LVIII between the [Kansas City Chiefs](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds/kansas-city-chiefs) and [San Francisco 49ers](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/odds/san-francisco-49ers) as an example. | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **Spread** | **Total** | **Moneyline** | | 49ers | -2.5
(-115) | 47.5
(-110) | -125 | | Chiefs | +2.5
(-105) | 47.5
(-110) | +105 | ## Types of NFL Bets You should have an understanding of the different types of bets, and the associated payout structure, before playing a wager on an NFL game. There are several popular NFL betting options that you can take advantage of each week to maximize your total payout like: - Moneyline - Against the Spread - Over/Under Totals ### NFL Moneyline Bets [Moneyline bets](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/moneyline) are the most simple as they only require a bettor to pick the team that they think will win a particular game or event regardless of the score or stats. Each moneyline game will feature a [favorite team](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/favorite) and an [underdog team](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/underdog). The favorite is the team seen as likely to win the contest, whereas the underdog is seen as likely to lose. A **favorite will be designated with a minus sign (-) while the underdog will be designated with a plus sign (+) in the moneyline**. Here’s an example using the Super Bowl LVIII matchup: | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **Spread** | **Total** | **Moneyline** | | 49ers | -2.5
(-115) | 47.5
(-110) | -125 | | Chiefs | +2.5
(-105) | 47.5
(-110) | +105 | You can tell that the 49ers were the favorite because they had a -125 designation, and the Chiefs were the underdog because they had a +105 designation. The numbers following the plus and minus signs indicate the associated payout amount for betting on each team. In this example, a $100 bet on the Chiefs at +105 odds would result in a $105 profit if they won the game. By contrast, the 49ers moneyline of -125 odds means that a bettor would win $100 for every $125 invested. Bettors must risk more money to profit when placing a wager on a favorite compared to an underdog. ### NFL Bets Against the Spread Also known as a [point spread bet](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/point-spread) or just the spread, this type of wager involves betting not on the winner of the game but on the margin of victory. In a margin of victory bet, the favored team (-) gives points to the underdog team (+) that they must “cover” in their margin of victory. Covering a spread means a team has beaten the point spread for that contest, and the bettor has won their wager. Here’s an example using Super Bowl LVIII. | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **Spread** | **Total** | **Moneyline** | | 49ers | -2.5
(-115) | 47.5
(-110) | -125 | | Chiefs | +2.5
(-105) | 47.5
(-110) | +105 | You need to be aware of two numbers when betting the spread. The first number is the spread itself (2.5 in this example). The spread number indicates the points the favorite must cover to beat the spread. If the 49ers won Super Bowl LVIII by three or more points, they cover the spread. Conversely, if the Chiefs win the game or lose by two or fewer points, they’ll cover the spread. If the spread was three (-3/+3) and the 49ers won by exactly three points, the teams will “ [push](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/push), " meaning no team covered the spread, and you will get the money back you placed on the wager. In some instances, oddsmakers will set an even spread. This means that each team is given the same likelihood of winning, and bettors pick who they think will win the contest. This may be referred to as a “ [pick ‘em](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/pickem)” matchup. The second number is the [juice](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/juice), or the vig, which is the “tax” that betters pay to a sportsbook to place their wager. In this example, each team has their own juice, meaning the tax will be slightly different depending on which team you bet on. The juice is -115 for the 49ers and -105 for the Chiefs. The juice works the same as money line bets when calculating your potential payout. Betting on the 49ers would net someone $100 for every $115 invested if they covered the spread, whereas a bettor would earn $100 for every $105 invested on the Chiefs if they covered the spread. ### NFL Over/Under Bets [Over/Under bets](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/over-under-total) are another popular option for NFL wagers. Also known as “totals”, this bet type requires you to decide how many total points will be scored in a contest by both teams combined. It does not matter which team wins or by how much; you are only concerned about the overall point total. | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **Spread** | **Total** | **Moneyline** | | 49ers | -2.5
(-115) | 47.5
(-110) | -125 | | Chiefs | +2.5
(-105) | 47.5
(-110) | +105 | Oddsmakers had set a total of 47.5 points for Super Bowl LVIII. Bettors who select the “over” would win if the Chiefs and 49ers score a combined 48 points or more. Bettors who choose the “under” would win if the teams score 47 points or less combined. Over/Under bets also have juice. The juice is the same for the over and the under in Super Bowl LVI at -110. This means bettors must invest $110 for every $100 worth of profit, regardless of what side of the total they pick. ## How to Read NFL Odds Now that you understand the different types of bets and the numbers on an odds table, let’s talk about the different types of odds that you may encounter in sports betting. There are three commonly used odd types: - American Odds - Decimal (European) Odds - Fractional (British) Odds ### How Do American Odds Work? American odds, as you likely guessed, are only used in sportsbooks within the United States. All of the examples used in this guide have utilized American odds, so you should be somewhat familiar with them at this point. [American odds](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/american-odds) are expressed as either a positive or negative whole number. A positive number (associated with the underdog team) indicates how much money a bettor will collect when wagering $100 dollars. A negative number (associated with the favorite team) indicates how much money must be risked in order to win $100. While American odds are set up to reflect $100 wagers and payouts, a bettor is not required to bet $100. The odds scale up and down based on how much money is wagered. For example, betting $10 on the Cincinnati Bengals (+165) in Super Bowl LVI would return a $16.50 profit for the bettor if the team won. A bet on the Rams (-200) means a $10 bet would net a $5 return for a Rams victory. ### How Do Decimal Odds Work? Decimal odds is the most commonly used odd type internationally, particularly in Europe. [Decimal odds](https://www.actionnetwork.com/education/decimal-odds) show the **total return for every $1 wagered, including the money risked**, as opposed to American odds that use a $100 scale. A common American odd line of -110 ($110 risked to earn $100) is converted to decimals as 1.91. This decimal means for every $1 risked, you will receive .91 cents in profit on top of the original dollar wagered. Favorites are represented by any decimal odd under 2.0 and underdogs are any decimal odd over 2.0. Decimal odds make calculating payouts easier as they only require a bettor to multiply their wager by the decimal odds. Back to Super Bowl LVI for an example: | | | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **American Odds** | **Decimal Odds** | **Risked** | **Profit** | **Payout** | | 49ers | -125 | 1.25 | $100 | $80 | $180 | | Chiefs | +105 | 2.05 | $100 | $105 | $205 | As you can see, **wager x decimal odds = possible payout**. Use [The Action Network’s Odds Calculator](https://www.actionnetwork.com/betting-calculators/betting-odds-calculator) to ensure that your odds conversions and payout calculations are always accurate. ### How Do Fractional Odds Work? Fractional odds are somewhat less commonplace overall, but are frequently used in the United Kingdom. **Fractional odds show the amount of money a bettor stands to win (the numerator) over the wager amount being risked (the denominator)**. It’s likely that you’ve heard someone say something along the lines of “I’ll give you two-to-one odds” on a particular contest. Those are fractional odds. Visually fractional odds look like this: 2/1. Two is the numerator and the one is the denominator. The favorite and underdog teams are determined by whether the fractional odds are greater than or less than one. If a team is given a **fractional odd whose total is less than one, they are the favorite**. A team with **fractional odds whose total is greater than one is the underdog**. Let’s break this all down with the Rams vs. Bengals matchup: | | | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **American Odds** | **Fractional Odds** | **Risked** | **Profit** | **Payout** | | 49ers | -125 | 4/5 | $100 | $80 | $180 | | Chiefs | +105 | 21/20 | $100 | $105 | $205 | Fractional odds can become confusing in instances like Super Bowl LVIII when a team like the Chiefs have odds that cannot be reduced down to a smaller fraction. Divide the top number by the bottom and multiply it by your wager to get the payout number. The payouts do not change from one odds type to the next, only the way the odds are presented and calculated. ## How to Use the Action Network's NFL Odds Page You will likely notice that moneylines, point spreads, and over/under totals vary from one sportsbook to the next for the same NFL game. It is smart practice to “shop for lines” before placing a wager. This simply means reviewing odds at various sportsbooks to find the one that offers the best payout potential. Line shopping can be pretty cumbersome for most betters, that is why The Action Network has condensed all the major sportsbooks NFL odds on this page for you to review without having to do all the legwork. Here are a few notes on how to get the most out of the NFL Odds page. - You’ll never have to guess which sportsbook has the best odds for a given game. The Action Network pulls in up-to-the-minute odds from every U.S. sportsbook and highlights the best odds in green across moneyline, spread, or over/under bets in the NFL.

- The NFL Odds page is customizable to only display the sportsbooks that you have an account with. This helps reduce the “noise” that you have to sort through to make a quick, smart betting decision. - Sportsbooks offer odds on specific timeframes within a game in addition to just the final outcome. For the NFL, this often includes specific odds for a specific quarter or half. The NFL Odds page allows you to filter between the various market timeframes to bet a game in a variety of different ways as it unfolds. - Sports betting is not currently legal in every state. As such, The Action Network NFL Odds page will allow you to see the sportsbook odds and prices available to you depending on where you are in the United States. ## Other Ways to Bet on the NFL Moneylines, spreads, and over/unders are some of the most common NFL betting types. There are other options available for those looking for different ways to get into the NFL action. - Parlay - Futures - Player Props - Daily Fantasy You can place parlay, futures, and player prop bets with sportsbooks like Fanatics, FanDuel, and DraftKings. Read our [Fanatics Sportsbook promo](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/fanatics-sportsbook) and review for the new user bonus. For more information about FanDuel and DraftKings, read our [FanDuel promo code](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/fanduel) and the [DraftKings promo code](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/draftkings). ### NFL Parlays Two or more wagers group a parlay to create a larger payout. For a parlay to payout, the bettor has to win each of the wagers in the parlay. This makes the chances of winning more difficult, but it can significantly increase your earnings. The more games added to a parlay, the higher the payout potential. Bettors can create a parlay by grouping bets, like a moneyline and an over/under total. Let’s refer back to the Super Bowl LVIII chart to make a $100 moneyline bet on the Chiefs and a bet on the 47.5 Over. | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Team** | **Spread** | **Total** | **Moneyline** | | 49ers | -2.5
(-115) | 47.5
(-110) | -125 | | Chiefs | +2.5
(-105) | 47.5
(-110) | +105 | Here’s how the two bets payout without being parlayed: - Chiefs moneyline (+105) at $50 - The potential winnings are $52.5 for a total payout of $102.50, including the original $50 risked. - Over 47.5 (-110) at $50 - The potential winnings are $45.45 for a total payout of $95.45, including the original $50 risked. - A bettor has the potential to win $97.95 in payouts for a total of $197.95, including the original $100 risked across the two separate bets. Here’s how the same bets would payout being parlayed together: - Chiefs moneyline (+105) AND Over 47.5 (-110) at $100 - The potential winnings are $291.36 for a total payout of $391.36, including the original $100 risked. As you can see, the payout potential for a parlay is significantly higher for wagering the same amount of money across identical bets. Oddsmakers give you better odds as you add more wagers to your parlay, but remember, you have to win each bet to cash out, so pick carefully. Lose just one bet in the parlay, and you lose all the money risked. Need help to calculate your parlay payouts? Don’t forget to take advantage of The Action Network’s [Betting Odds Calculator](https://www.actionnetwork.com/betting-calculators/betting-odds-calculator). ### NFL Futures Futures bets are exactly what they sound like betting on an event where the outcome will be settled in the future (not within the same day or week). Futures bets exclusively deal with moneylines. Examples of futures betting for the NFL include placing a wager on a team to win the Super Bowl at the beginning of the season, NFL MVP, division winners, and playoff teams. Futures bets are inherently tricky because they require a bettor to predict the outcome of an NFL event without any knowledge of how the season may unfold. As such, the odds for futures bets tend to be highly favorable to a bettor should they win. Be sure to check out The Action Network’s [NFL Futures](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/futures) page to familiarize yourself with the various wager options available for the 2024-25 season. ### NFL Prop Bets Oddsmakers also make lines for individual NFL player performances that bettors can wager on. These are known as prop bets. Prop bets utilize the over/under mechanism, meaning bettors must decide if a player will exceed or fall short of a projected stat line. Need help sorting through prop bet options? The [Action Labs](https://labs.actionnetwork.com/) Prop Tool will help you organize, sort, and grade hundreds of prop bet odds throughout the NFL season. Get access to picks from experts like [Sean Koerner](https://www.actionnetwork.com/article/author/sean-koerner) to really set yourself up for success in 2024-25. Check out other pages, such as our [NFL Props Picks](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/prop-projections) page, our [NFL Props](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/props) Hub, and [Touchdown Props](https://www.actionnetwork.com/nfl/props/touchdown-props) Hub. ### NFL Daily Fantasy Daily fantasy sports (DFS) have become wildly popular across the country, especially in states where sports betting is not yet legal. DFS is a great option for people living in a state where online sports betting has not been legalized to still get in on the action week in and week out. There are a variety of daily fantasy sports options. Most people are familiar with traditional fantasy football, which involves drafting a team and setting a lineup each week. DFS is different, where you can “draft” new players each week based on matchups to compete for payouts. Sportsbooks like DraftKings and FanDuel offer daily fantasy options. Other popular alternatives are the [PrizePicks promo code](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/prizepicks), daily fantasy with a twist, and the [Fliff promo code](https://www.actionnetwork.com/online-sports-betting/reviews/fliff-social-sportsbook), which is a social sportsbook option. Get a competitive edge using Action’s [FantasyLabs](https://www.fantasylabs.com/) to break down player stats and matchups and set a winning lineup each week. ## NFL Betting Help After reading this NFL betting guide, you should be able to read NFL odds and understand the difference between bet types. Still, you may need a little help making the best wagers week-to-week. Here are a few tools from The Action Network that can help. ### NFL Public Betting Percentages The Action Network collects a vast amount of betting data on every NFL game, including the number of bets and how much money is placed on them. We condense this information into an easy-to-read interactive chart that helps you to assess what bets are most popular amongst the public and where the majority of the money is being wagered. Whether you choose to go along with how the majority has placed its bets, or you choose to break from the pack, is up to you.
